summary.headline: Neapolitan Codex: Lunar Astrology
summary.text: Catalog entries for a Neapolitan codex covering planetary herbs, Rhetorius on stars unconnected to the luminaries, Heliodorus on planetary rulers of weekdays and hours, lunar light and eclipses, lunar observations by Mazounates, weather-sign stars, Melampus’s lunar prognostications, and a Valens oracle with appended tables.
